topic.summary: On a review of current and evolving liquidity conditions in the near term, it has been decided to conduct a Variable Rate Repo (VRR) auction on Wednesday, October 21, 2026, as under:                         Sl. No.          Notified Amount(₹ crore)          Tenor          (day)          Window Timing          Date of Reversal                          1          50,000          1          09:30 AM to 10:00 AM          October 22, 2026          (Thursday)                    2. The operational guidelines for the auction will be same as given in Reserve Bank’s Press Release 2021-2022/1572 dated January 20, 2022.      Ajit Prasad                  Deputy General Manager        (Communications)          Press Release: 2026-2027/1355
